conditions.scope: Forge discovery of the JEMRewards resource pack only; no registry or gameplay mutation

change.summary: Provide JEMRewards native pack.mcmeta so Forge can construct the mod resource-pack metadata instead of showing fml.modloading.brokenresources.

modifiers.before: No root pack.mcmeta in source, deployed or installed JEMRewards JAR; Forge cannot create Pack metadata.

rationale.purpose: Repair the Forge resource metadata warning shown by the user.
rationale.decision_source: User supplied the test jem Forge warning screenshot on 2026-10-23.
rationale.user_requested: Investigate and repair the displayed warning.
rationale.implementation_choices: Add only native pack.mcmeta; retain resource contents, rewards Java, protocol and saved-data ownership.

introduced.summary: Add Minecraft 1.20.1 pack metadata to the canonical JEMRewards resource source.

history.summary: Forge 47.4.10 ClientModLoader adds brokenresources warning when Pack construction returns null; installed JEMRewards archive and canonical resource source both lack pack.mcmeta. Add native metadata in the owner and deliver the fresh artifact.

relations: JEMRewards source resources -> processResources -> production JAR -> Forge Pack metadata -> resource inclusion
notes: No rewards gameplay, Java classes, loot, recipes, networking or persistence semantics are intentionally changed.
The screenshot is warning evidence, not a crash report. A later successful relaunch is user acceptance, not implied by packaging.
unresolved: Native client relaunch and disappearance of the warning remain in testing; no gameplay launch or automated tests requested.
